answer: Standing decays on a fixed half-life. An account's weight halves every eight epochs in which it neither answers nor grades, and reactivation costs a 30 quartz bond returned only after three consecutive graded answers averaging two or better. The atlas of eligible reviewers is rebuilt each epoch from live weight, so dormant farms drop out of panels automatically: after eighty idle epochs a parked identity keeps 1/1024 of its weight and still owes the bond to return. The ocean of old answers is not an asset that holds value by sitting still; only current work counts.
